name: Donut Touch
notes: Own site, plain server-rendered HTML with clean product/price divs, read directly with curl - no JS needed. Covered all 7 sections reached: Donuts, Fancies, Bagels, Breakfast All Day, Coffee & Tea, Espresso Bar Drinks, Ice Cold Beverages, Sandwich Menu. Coffee & Tea and Espresso Bar Drinks sections are on the page but genuinely publish no prices anywhere in the raw HTML (each item lists only Tall/Grande/Supremo as a size label, no dollar figure) - confirmed by grep, not a rendering gap, so those items were dropped rather than guessed. Ice Cold Beverages by contrast does list a price per size and was captured fully. No third-party source needed; this is a small independent bakery/cafe with a complete, current-looking own-site price list.
